note: WO-29 §D: reconciled to consistently follow WO-11 decision 7's Adult Trap redefinition (docs/WO-11-implementation-notes-questioning-adult-trap.md — 'a familiar everyday rule or practice the parent follows but cannot readily explain, not a science fact the adult gets wrong'). The prior 9 mixed real customs (kept) with science facts (snow colour, day length, mochi's starch chemistry, why warm food feels comforting) that matched the OLD, superseded definition — those 4 are replaced with everyday New Year/winter customs an adult participates in every year without necessarily being able to explain their origin (New Year's Eve soba, hatsumode, kadomatsu/shimekazari, osechi's variety, mochi-eating itself rather than why it stretches, and year-end cleaning). Every card stays a plain odai prompt, same as every other card in the deck — the co-learning, non-adversarial framing comes from how the kit's own Adult Memo/Rules sheets frame play, not from special wording on the card itself.
